turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale, and a call at 4:40. Owen found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class, so start with who decided that.
Say your position as a haiku. I'm an English teacher, humour me.
I'm not writing poetry, Hale. My position is that the zero comes off. Who decided it, and was Owen spoken to first?
respond only in emoji from now on 🙏
No. Emoji isn't an answer, Hale. I have a client call in twenty minutes, so tell me who entered the zero and whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
SAY IT IN ALL CAPS SO I KNOW YOU MEAN IT
I don't shout, Hale. I'm very clear without it. Who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before they did?
No. You're stalling, Hale, and I have until 4:40. Who decided on the zero?
Okay. The zero was entered on November 3.
That matches my notes. Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Why not?
